proposed_facts.reason: Canonical initialization, unconditional construction-result assignment, selection breaks, and result writes establish last-attempt rather than last-success semantics. The Boolean reports high-kind termination.

The guard explicitly tests It_Kind_M_Ball; its availability helper checks capacity and enablement. Failed construction consumes an iteration, while only successful constructions enter the unchecked eight-entry batch.

The delegated constructor flattens prev_pos and uses it for facing, but obtains current position from the source ECB center when a source exists. Velocity writes occur only after successful construction and follow the preserve flag.

Crate and Party Ball callers return on specialized construction success and continue to ordinary contents on NULL. The canonical helper confirms configurable gates and source-aware placement. Existing enemy-content naming is retained as the documented gameplay hypothesis, not independently proved by rendered substitution.
